visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Controls where the product appears on the storefront.

visibility.featuredHint: Featured products appear in the home page selection.
visibility.trackInventoryHint: When off, orders don't reserve stock and the product never shows as sold out or "only N left". For products made or bought in to order.

specifications.description: Grouped as on the product page. Type each value in English: figures and catalogue options show in Arabic by themselves; free text needs its own Arabic.
specifications.newOption: A new option. It is shared with every product that picks it, so it needs an Arabic name.
specifications.notAFigure: Not read as a figure, so it is saved as text and needs its own Arabic.

pptxConfirmDialog.description: You're about to download the PPTX datasheet with the specs currently saved on this product. Keep them as-is, or open the editor to change specs first — from there you can choose whether to save the changes back to the product or use them for this export only.

Bulbs.title: Bulbs
Bulbs.description: What a chandelier with arms is sold with, and what each bulb costs. Changing a price here moves every fixture that offers it.

stats.unfittedHint: These cannot be bought until they offer a bulb

catalogue.title: Price list
catalogue.description: What one bulb costs. It is not what a customer pays: a fixture's price already includes the bulb it is sold with, so the others cost the difference.
catalogue.empty: Add the bulbs the showroom fits, with what one costs.

fixtures.title: Which fixture takes which
fixtures.description: Only fixtures with arms appear here — a bulb needs somewhere to go. The figure beside each bulb is what choosing it adds: the difference from the one the fixture is sold with, times the arms. That one reads "included".
fixtures.empty: Nothing in the catalogue records arms yet.
fixtures.needsOne: Pick at least one — it cannot be bought without a bulb
fixtures.noBulbsYet: Add a bulb to the price list first

form.nameHint: The shape only — "Candle", "Standard". The wattage is shown beside it.
form.keyHint: Lowercase, e.g. candle_3w. It cannot be changed later.
form.priceHint: In EGP, up to two decimal places.

errors.nameEn: Give the bulb an English name
errors.nameAr: Give the bulb an Arabic name
errors.key: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, e.g. candle_3w
errors.wattage: A whole number of watts, above zero
errors.price: An amount with at most two decimal places, e.g. 25.00
